section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses various methods for measuring creative achievement, including expert ratings, nonexpert ratings, and general population rating scales. It highlights MacKinnon's (1962) use of expert ratings for architectural creativity, Ludwig's (1992) development of the Creative Achievement Scale (CAS) for 1,006 deceased luminaries across 19 professions, and Richards et al.'s (1988) Lifetime Creativity Scales for measuring everyday creativity in unselected samples.
